en.h1: LG Washing Machine Drum Not Turning
en.description: The drum does not rotate during the wash or spin phase.
en.quick_fix: Check the selected cycle, load, closed door and drainage, then stop if the drum remains stationary (about 5–20 minutes).
en.intro_html:
The drum does not rotate during the wash or spin phase.

Check the selected cycle, load, closed door and drainage, then stop if the drum remains stationary. Do not guess an internal part from the code or symptom, and open or measure no internal circuits.

causes_json.detail: The complete code determines the correct troubleshooting path.
External operating conditions can stop a cycle or drum movement.
A documented restart can rule out a temporary condition.

causes_json.cause: Internal motor, sensor or control fault
causes_json.detail: A persistent code or stationary drum requires diagnosis.

steps_json.detail: Pause the programme, wait for the drum to stop and do not force the door.
Check the selected cycle, load, closed door and drainage, then stop if the drum remains stationary.
Use the model number and complete code; perform documented user checks only.
Unplug with dry hands as the manufacturer advises and restart only without leakage, smell, smoke, heat or electrical damage.
Request service if the code or symptom returns. Remove no panels and measure no sensors, motors or boards.

en.when_to_call_technician_html:
Arrange authorised service if the code returns after one restart, if the drum does not rotate or if the exact manual identifies an internal sensor, motor, communication or control fault.

Unplug immediately for water near electricity, burning smell, smoke, sparks, abnormal heat or tripped protection.
en.prevention_html:
Follow load limits, empty pockets, keep the washer level and always record the full code and model number before contacting support.

Internal sensor, motor, communication and electronics faults cannot be safely prevented or diagnosed through dismantling.

Use the model number and complete code; perform documented user checks only.
Unplug with dry hands as the manufacturer advises and restart only without leakage, smell, smoke, heat or electrical damage.
Request service if the code or symptom returns. Remove no panels and measure no sensors, motors or boards.

en.when_to_call_technician_html:
Arrange authorised service if the code returns after one restart, if the drum does not rotate or if the exact manual identifies an internal sensor, motor, communication or control fault.

Unplug immediately for water near electricity, burning smell, smoke, sparks, abnormal heat or tripped protection.
en.prevention_html:
Follow load limits, empty pockets, keep the washer level and always record the full code and model number before contacting support.

Internal sensor, motor, communication and electronics faults cannot be safely prevented or diagnosed through dismantling.

faq_json.question: Can I keep using a Bosch washer showing 1C?
faq_json.answer: Switch the washer off for one minute once and restart; request Samsung service if 1C returns. Do not run another cycle until Bosch guidance or service confirms it is safe.

faq_json.question: Can I reset 1C by switching the washer off?
faq_json.answer: Switching off is a safety step, not proof that the fault is repaired. If the code returns or Bosch classifies it as service-only, do not repeatedly reset the washer.

faq_json.question: Does 1C identify a part to replace?
faq_json.answer: No. The code identifies a system or condition, but Bosch service should diagnose the exact cause before any part is ordered.

faq_json.question: Why should I provide the E-Nr?
faq_json.answer: Bosch model families and markets can use different hardware and service procedures. The E-Nr identifies the correct appliance documentation.

faq_json.question: May I test the sensor myself?
faq_json.answer: No. Do not remove panels or measure internal wiring, sensors or electronics. Bosch directs these codes to customer service.

sv.description: Samsung anger att 1c är ett fel på vattennivågivaren.
sv.quick_fix: Stäng av tvättmaskinen i en minut en gång och starta om; boka Samsung-service om 1C återkommer (cirka 5–20 minuter).

Stäng av tvättmaskinen i en minut en gång och starta om; boka Samsung-service om 1C återkommer. Gissa inte en intern del från koden eller symptomet och öppna eller mät inga interna kretsar.

steps_json.detail: Pausa programmet, vänta tills trumman står stilla och tvinga inte luckan.

sv.when_to_call_technician_html:
Boka auktoriserad service om koden återkommer efter en omstart, om trumman inte roterar eller om exakt manual anger ett internt givar-, motor-, kommunikations- eller styrfel.

sv.prevention_html:

faq_json.question: Kan jag fortsätta använda maskinen med 1C?
faq_json.answer: Stäng av tvättmaskinen i en minut en gång och starta om; boka Samsung-service om 1C återkommer. Kör inte ett nytt program innan Bosch eller en servicetekniker har bekräftat att det är säkert.

faq_json.question: Kan jag återställa 1C genom att stänga av?
faq_json.answer: Avstängning är en säkerhetsåtgärd, inte bevis på att felet är löst. Återställ inte maskinen upprepade gånger om koden återkommer.

faq_json.question: Visar 1C vilken reservdel som ska bytas?
faq_json.answer: Nej. Koden identifierar ett system eller tillstånd, men Bosch service ska diagnostisera den exakta orsaken före beställning.

faq_json.question: Varför behöver Bosch E‑Nr?
faq_json.answer: Bosch-serier och marknader kan ha olika maskinvara och serviceförfaranden. E‑Nr identifierar rätt dokumentation.

faq_json.question: Kan jag själv testa sensorn?
faq_json.answer: Nej. Ta inte bort paneler och mät inte interna ledningar, sensorer eller elektronik. Bosch hänvisar dessa koder till service.
